evidence.quote: And with unemployment at 4.5 percent, we are at or close to full employment.

Although job growth has been strong, gross domestic product has increased only about 2 percent annually since the crisis, held down by the weakest sustained period of labor productivity growth since World War II.
For the most part, these policies are not in the purview of the Federal Reserve.
I support adjustments designed to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of regulation without sacrificing safety and soundness or undermining macroprudential goals.

parsed.rationale: The speech focuses on financial regulation and its post-crisis reforms, offering no view on interest rates or inflation. Its description of the economy, near full employment but with weak productivity, is balanced, so the stance is neutral.
